edits.new: - The ACE schema in DEV and SIT is at the common migration head (V026 at the time of writing, legacy RWB-ACE-001 section 3). The ACE DBA allocates this story's migration version on the ACE schema's own Flyway sequence at build time, and the file keeps the legacy name form V<version>__rwb_ace_001_recovery_source_additions.sql; the version number is Not specified in the source documents until then (GAP-2165; GAP-0517; CG-ALL-1839; ASM-3469).

edits.old: - The ACE ingestion framework accepts a new source: a file or API contract, a staging-to-target mapper, a batch record writer and a unique business key per target table (legacy section 3).
edits.new:
- The ACE ingestion framework accepts a new source: a file or API contract, a staging-to-target mapper, a batch record writer and a unique business key per target table (legacy section 3).
- Each of the 14 ACE ingestion jobs keeps the interface number recorded from Interface Specifications v3; ACE keeps its own job names and cadence. The numbers and cadence are Not specified in the source documents until recorded at build time (GAP-0517; GAP-2165).

edits.old: - The NOLOGIN role `ace_view_owner` exists, or is created once for the read path, and no credential appears in a migration, a script or a runbook (TSD P1 T6.3; DP-02). edits.new: - The NOLOGIN role `ace_view_owner` exists, or is created once for the read path, and no credential appears in a migration, a script or a runbook (TSD P1 T6.3; DP-02). The grantee is `ace_view_owner` only: SELECT on the 14 tables goes to that role and the 12 columns are covered by the table SELECT. The service logins keep SELECT on the views and hold no public grant (GAP-2165; GAP-0518; ASM-3470).

edits.old: the extract carries legacy keys only (GAP-0532).

the extract carries legacy keys only (GAP-0532).
- No other service writes rwb_source_data. The command operations for the party flags and for contact consent and verification are to be defined in the P1 rwb-source-data contract (GAP-0245).
- DL43 is open: the P3 features that read the Tier 2 additions (batch status, party product, credit decision) stay behind their feature flags until the additions land. The fallback date per flag is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1557).
- The two platform dependencies of the applied patterns are recorded here as notes; the build dependency stays None as the Work Package fixes it. Their names are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2165).

edits.new:
never through SQL on a screen.
